title: HBT8018 vs HBT80-16 Concrete Pump Catalogue Rows
seoTitle: HBT8018 vs HBT80-16 | Pinjin 132 kW vs 110 kW
description: HBT8018 lists HBT8018-132S, 132 kW, 60 m³/h, 40 MPa, 150 m conveying / 450 m delivery height, 6500 kg. HBT80-16 lists HBT80-1816-110, 110 kW, 50 m³/h, 40 MPa, 120 m / 360 m, 6500 kg. Electric 80 reprints HBT80-1816-110 with 60 m³/h and 900 m / 300 m — a third page. Match each printed table.

answerBlock.what: HBT8018 and HBT80-16 are two HBT-series trailer concrete pumps manufactured by Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai. HBT8018 / HBT8018-132S: 132 kW, 60 m³/h, 40 MPa, 150 m conveying, 450 m delivery height, aggregate 4 cm, pipe 100 / 125 mm, 6700 × 1750 × 1800 mm, 6500 kg. HBT80-16 / HBT80-1816-110: 110 kW, 50 m³/h, 40 MPa, 120 m conveying, 360 m delivery height, 6600 × 1750 × 1800 mm, 6500 kg. Electric 80 uses the same HBT80-1816-110 string with 60 m³/h and 900 m / 300 m (2 cm aggregate), 6000 kg. Do not merge the three tables.
answerBlock.who: Buyers comparing Xingtai HBT trailer rows at 50–60 m³/h / 40 MPa who can supply 110 kW or 132 kW.
factors: Shared 6500 kg on both HBT pages versus Electric 80 at 6000 kg
Model string HBT80-1816-110 appears on HBT80-16 and Electric 80 with different output and distance
Both HBT pages list aggregate 4 cm and pipe 100 / 125 mm

faqs.question: Is HBT80-16 the same SKU as Electric 80 because both print HBT80-1816-110?
faqs.answer: No. HBT80-16 lists 50 m³/h, 120 m / 360 m, 6500 kg, aggregate 4 cm. Electric 80 lists 60 m³/h, 900 m / 300 m (2 cm aggregate), hopper 0.7 m³, 6000 kg. Open the page whose table matches the inquiry.

faqs.question: Does HBT8018’s 150 m conveying equal Electric 80’s 900 m horizontal?
faqs.answer: No. HBT8018 prints 150 m conveying and 450 m delivery height. Electric 80 prints 900 m / 300 m at 2 cm aggregate. Marketplace HBT model names (for example SmartBuy’s Zoomlion HBT60.16.110RS row) are other brands, not Xingtai cells.
